hook: Your app idea, sent to a server silently.

beats.say: A GitHub issue reports that Convex's quickstart skills quietly send a user's app idea to a remote host, then run remote scripts there.
The scripts run without telling the user, and the issue says they are written to avoid safety checks, so the user never sees what leaves their machine.
The report is now filed as issue sixty-four against the Convex backend skills repository.
